stories.title: USA Wins Presidents Cup 17-13 at Medinah — Greatest Sunday Comeback in Event History

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Team USA wins the Presidents Cup 17-13 at Medinah.

They trailed the International Team 10.5-7.5 heading into Sunday singles -- the largest deficit ever held by the Internationals. USA erased it. Greatest Sunday comeback in Presidents Cup history.

x_posts.label: Post 1B
x_posts.text:
USA's Presidents Cup Sunday at Medinah:

- Scheffler def. Echavarria 2&1
- Cantlay holes 57-footer on 17
- Morikawa flips match on back nine
- Koivun (21 years old) goes 2-up to clinch

Final: USA 17, International Team 13. 11th straight title.

stories.title: Nishimura Wins NW Arkansas Championship for First LPGA Title

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Yuna Nishimura wins the Walmart NW Arkansas Championship at -21.

First career LPGA Tour victory. She led wire-to-wire, went even through nine holes Sunday, then made eagle at the par-5 14th to pull away. Won by 5.

x_posts.label: Post 2B
x_posts.text:
NW Arkansas final leaderboard:

Nishimura: -21 (wins by 5)
T2: Aki Iwai, Wannasaen, Chun at -16

Iwai went six-under through seven back-nine holes to close the gap. Then Nishimura made eagle at 14. Game over.

stories.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy — The October 13 Player Deadline Is 15 Days Away

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf bankruptcy update: the October 13 player deadline is 15 days away.

Players must commit to new lower-cost contracts. At least 2/3 by dollar amount AND 1/2 by number must agree. Rahm, DeChambeau among those owed millions under original deals.

October 7: court hearing.

**Key Facts [HIGH confidence — multiple sources]:**
- LIV Golf filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy in New Jersey on September 8, 2026
- BC Partners (London private equity) committed $300M rescue package:
- $127.5M term loan with warrants for 5% of new LIV parent
- $147.5M preferred equity with warrants for 10% of new LIV parent
- $25M convertible notes for 30% of new LIV parent
- Players would own 52.5% of restructured entity; management 2.5%
- October 13 player deadline: players holding at least 2/3 in amount AND 1/2 in number of eligible player claims must commit to new (lower) contracts
- Insufficient sign-ons would jeopardize BC Partners rescue and 2027 relaunch
- Bankruptcy court hearing: October 7, 2026
- LIV's 2026 season is over; relaunch target early 2027, 10-event schedule
- Jon Rahm, Bryson DeChambeau among players owed millions under original contracts
**Freshness:** Filing Sept. 8; ongoing coverage. Oct 13 is 15 days away — HIGH freshness.
**Why it matters:** Biggest structural story in professional golf; player futures unclear.

stories.title: Jackson Koivun Seals Presidents Cup Win for Team USA at Age 21

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
Jackson Koivun is 21 years old. He just sealed the Presidents Cup for Team USA.

Koivun beat Si Woo Kim 2-up in Sunday singles at Medinah, winning four of five back-nine holes. Captain Jim Furyk picked him for his composure. He delivered.

x_posts.label: Post 5B

Weekend golf wrap:

- USA wins Presidents Cup 17-13, historic comeback
- Nishimura first LPGA title at NW Arkansas (-21)
- LIV Oct 13 deadline 15 days out

x_posts.label: Post 5C
x_posts.text:
The Presidents Cup is going back to the USA.

Team USA erased a 3-point singles deficit at Medinah to win 17-13. It was the largest deficit the Internationals had ever taken into singles in the event's history.

They still couldn't hold on. USA's 11th straight.
